title: Cyclodextrin-threaded covalent organic polyrotaxanes with tunable solid-state emissive activity for efficient iodine capture
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,42347-42353
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06071K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xia Guo, Xueling Zhou, Qiupeng Gu, Xiaohong Zhang, Yanyan Tang
Molecular threading creates a covalent organic polyrotaxane (TPE-CD-COPR) for superior iodine capture, combining high capacity, fast kinetics, and recyclability with tunable emission and aqueous compatibility.
